evidence.claim: Dominance and silence thresholds are enforced, not documented: share > 2/n dominates; share < 0.25/n or zero turns is silent. A planted even 4-seat council is unflagged on both measures. A filler-padded chair is volume-dominant and not substance-dominant; a terse skeptic is the reverse.

probes.raw_output: dominance fires iff share > 2/n; silence fires iff turns==0 or share < 0.25/n

evidence.claim: Both measures were computed over 20 recorded councils. They disagree on 12 runs: ['rec-02', 'rec-03', 'rec-06', 'rec-09', 'rec-10', 'rec-12', 'rec-13', 'rec-15', 'rec-16', 'rec-17', 'rec-18', 'rec-20']. Disagreement_count is the published volume-vs-substance figure the catalog asked for.
